heroHeadline: Haiti Postpones December 13 Elections as Salvadoran Troops Search for Four Missing Technicians
heroSubtitle: On October 18 gangs attacked a Salvadoran Gang Suppression Force armored vehicle with explosives; four Salvadoran technicians remain missing and more than 2,000 Salvadoran troops have reportedly been sent to Haiti. The electoral council has postponed the December 13 vote and announced new dates of July 18 and October 4.
